description: React component for a modal dialog that allows users to reset or change their status (e.g., Away, Do not disturb, Offline, Online, Out of office) in Mattermost. It manages state, handles user interactions, and displays localized messages.

classes.name: ResetStatusModal
classes.description: React component class for the reset status modal dialog.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes the component by fetching the user's status and setting modal visibility.

methods.name: hideModal
methods.description: Hides the modal by updating the state.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Handles user confirmation, updates status, and saves preferences if checked.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Handles user cancellation, resets preferences if checked.

methods.name: renderModalMessage
methods.description: Returns the localized message to display in the modal based on current status.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal component with appropriate props and localized messages.
